description: Smart Data Models defines harmonised EPANET-derived entities for water management, including curves, junctions, patterns, pipes, pumps and reservoirs. This resource is provided by smart-data-models (repository owner). Coverage is global as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. Access is through the linked repository or provider page; the exact file formats are not fully established. Licence: CC-BY-3.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: These are data schemas, not a hydraulic solver or an inventory of a particular utility. For simulation, it can supply inputs or comparison evidence. Related catalogue record: model-epanet. The relationship follows the named method or resource; it does not certify file compatibility.
